items: Cook bacon crisp and reserve drippings.
In bacon drippings, cook onion until tender.
Add flour, stirring and cooking until mixture turns golden.
Gradually add hot chicken stock, stirring to prevent lumps, and cook and stir until bubbly and slightly thickened.
Add cream, potatoes, spices, and salt and pepper. Simmer (do not boil) for 10 minutes.
Turn off heat and add cheese and green onions.
Garnish with some additional bacon, cheese, and green onions, if desired.

notes.title: Open questions
items: The source lists "1 c. diced onion" twice (once in each column). Is it 1 cup or 2 cups? I kept one.
